description:
Extend the provider-wire types so a step can carry a model's tool_use emissions and can feed tool_result blocks back on the next step.

=== Scope ===

- Extend ContentBlock (src/provider/anthropic.rs or its extracted-crate equivalent, whichever lands first — coordinate with bl-d15d epic): add ToolUse { id, name, input: serde_json::Value } and ToolResult { tool_use_id, content, is_error: bool }. Keep Unknown fallback for forward-compat (§4.4 shape).
- Message content becomes polymorphic — a user message can now be an array of content blocks mixing Text + ToolResult. Provider Request 'messages' accepts both legacy string content and array content.
- Add 'tools: Option<Vec<ToolDecl>>' to Request, matching Anthropic Messages API shape: { name, description, input_schema: json }.
- Extend step::StepResponse (or introduce a sibling structured record) so the follow-up response.json commit preserves tool_use blocks structurally — not just the concatenated .text(). Ball #3 consumes this to decide whether to loop.
- Pure wire/type ball: no loop changes, no tool executor. Tests exercise serde round-trips against synthetic payloads. No live API.

=== Depends on ===

bl-e2fb — must be closed before claiming; tool_call commit shape + tool_result framing decisions from that ball inform the StepResponse extension here.

=== Out of scope ===

- Request-time 'tools:' assembly from config (ball pinned by #1, implemented in #3 or later).
- Tool executor (#4).
title: v0.3 wire types: tool_use / tool_result blocks + tools request field
